rationale: Story s13 relies on the FileCommit owned by s2 for caller-owned edges: re-indexing a file replaces only the relationships that originate in it, and an edge into an entity that no longer exists after the commit returns to pending; s13 then re-resolves those pending rows by their binding key when a matching entity is stored (its ac6). Stakeholder decision 2026-10-17 (option A): s13 does not build the file commit itself.

citations.ref: chat 2026-10-17: s13 boundary decision option A
